ptxt.intxrefpoff: Valve and Cylinder Head Disassembly and Reassembly:K14D

item.ptxt: Remove all carbon deposits from combustion chambers.

attention4.ptxt: Metal surfaces can be scuffed or nicked when removing carbon deposits with sharp-edged tool.
Do not use any sharp-edged tool to scrape off carbon deposits from engine parts.

item.ptxt: Check cylinder head for crack on intake and exhaust ports, combustion chambers and head surface.

servinfosub.title: Cylinder Head Flatness
servinfosub.ptxt: Using straightedge (1) and feeler gauge (2), check flatness of gasket surface at a total of 6 positions.

If any measured value exceeds its limit, correct gasket surface with a surface plate and abrasive paper #400 (waterproof silicon carbide abrasive paper) by placing abrasive paper on surface plate and rubbing gasket surface against paper to grind high spots.
If it is impossible to correct cylinder head distortion, replace cylinder head.

attention3.ptxt: Distorted mating surface of cylinder head and cylinder head gasket causes combustion gas and/or coolant leakage, overheating and reduced power output.

spec.title: Distortion of mating surface of cylinder head and cylinder head gasket

servinfosub.title: Manifold Seating Surface Flatness
servinfosub.ptxt: Using straightedge (1) and feeler gauge (2), check flatness of manifold seating surface.
If measured value exceeds its limit, correct seating surface or replace cylinder head.

spec.title: Distortion of seating surfaces for intake manifold and turbocharger on cylinder head
